text:
Riley (CEO): Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands re: headcount plan, capacity swaps, and how offers get handled. Leaving answers here for the folks who asked during Q&A.
Noemi (People Ops): First question that came up 1: if teams are asked to reassign headcount to central infra, will that be permanent or temporary?
Riley (CEO): The majority are permanent reassignments where the work is clearly a shared platform responsibility. For tactical, short-lived needs we'll prefer temporary reassignments with an explicit sunset.
Hank (Head Eng): For the permanent moves, who approves the budget transfer? Is a finance signature required?
Noemi (People Ops): If the move crosses cost centers we need finance sign-off. Manager + receiving lead sign-off is sufficient if within the same cost center. Use the OrgOps form for auditability.
Olivia (Recruiting): How do these reassignments affect open reqs and candidate offers? Do we retitle reqs or close and reopen?
Noemi (People Ops): Best practice: convert the existing req when >50% of the role maps to the new scope and notify Recruiting. If its a net-new role, open a new req. Verbal offers are honored at the band active at offer issue; if bands shift upward before acceptance, managers may apply a one-time uplift.
Tariq (Product): If my product pod contributes an IC to a central team, is there guaranteed priority to backfill or will we lose velocity?
Riley (CEO): We will prioritize backfills within the quarter for product pods that contribute headcount. If backfill timing slips, teams get contractor runway and roadmap reprioritization support.
Megan (Manager): What's the SLA for filling infra-critical roles? Were worried about coverage during the transition.
Olivia (Recruiting): For roles tagged "infra-critical" we can allocate extra sourcer/recruiter time and target a 3-week interview SLA. Use the Greenhouse tag and cc me.
Hank (Head Eng): Are we loosening hiring bar or making exceptions to bring people on faster?
Riley (CEO): No, hiring bar stands. We will authorize short-term contractor coverage and accelerate cycles, but quality bar remains non-negotiable.
Noemi (People Ops): People asked about referral bonuses for swapped roles  will referrals still apply if a hire is a repurposed req?
Olivia (Recruiting): Referral bonus applies only to net-new headcount that results in a new headcount on payroll. Internal repurposes/reassignments do not trigger referral payouts.
Tariq (Product): Calibration confusion: different pods seem to expect different L4/L5 scope. Will there be a leveling calibration?
Noemi (People Ops): Yes  were running two cross-org calibration sessions next week (Eng/Product) and will publish a short rubric update. Calendar invites in ~15m.
org-bot: Reminder: submit OrgOps requests here: /forms/org-ops. Deadline for Q2 planning window: Mon EOD.
Megan (Manager): For managers who temporarily lose headcount, is there a priority queue to get that headcount back?
Riley (CEO): Yes  managers who contribute headcount to a strategic centralization will be added to a priority backfill queue for the quarter. Well make exceptions case-by-case.
Noemi (People Ops): Also FYI: contractors for coverage are auto-approved up to 10 weeks. Longer requires a short business case to People Ops.
Hank (Head Eng): Transfer approval flow: manager + receiving lead sign-off; if cross-cost center add finance. Escalate to me or Noemi for disputes.
Olivia (Recruiting): If anyone needs urgent sourcing help, DM me the hiring manager + job link and I'll reallocate capacity.
Tariq (Product): Will we get a public headcount snapshot per pod so we can plan roadmaps?
Noemi (People Ops): Yes  live headcount matrix will be posted in #all-hands-docs by EOD with a diff view and notes on reassignments.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Leveling calibration (Eng/Product)"  Wed 11am PT.
Megan (Manager): Thanks  this helps. Can we keep the thread open for edge cases?
Riley (CEO): Absolutely. If you have pending offers, promo packets, or cross-budget swaps that need urgent attention, ping Noemi + Olivia and put "URGENT-offer" in the subject. Leaving thread open. :handshake:
